# Anti-slop source

Source: https://github.com/dmmulroy/anti-slop

Commit: `c44ef22ca116d0ba62a3ff663a0bd13a3f3fa40b`

License: MIT; see LICENSE.

The selected rule files and their shared helpers are copied unchanged from `src/`.
The local index registers only the 13 approved rules. The five disabled rules and the Effect plugin are not registered.
The app pins matching Oxlint and plugin-host versions. Run the lint-policy fixtures after any update.
